systems.country_label: WAPIS; its centre is the DACORE (data collection and registration centre)
systems.owner: Ghana Police Service with INTERPOL; funded by the European Union
systems.tiers: a DACORE in Accra and more than 35 units in the capital across police, immigration and prisons, with the regions to follow (August 2019)

note: An INTERPOL newsletter on a police information system: local authorities appear only as officials met in Mali, The Gambia and Liberia; for Ghana it describes law enforcement sites in Accra and nothing of local government.
